1168-3510-4875-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Conspiracy.
1168-3510-4875-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Conspiracy and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Toggo to trigger.
Resolve a Toggo trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

206-751-4289.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1722-2034-3583-5468.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-2034-3583-5468.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters, Kambal triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent loses 1 life.
Oloro triggers. Holding prioirty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

654-4863-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
654-4863-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Revolutionist and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
654-4863-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Revolutionist and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

222-527-728-1322.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3090-5571-6495--6.description:
Use Harmless Offering to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
3090-5571-6495--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-5131-5330-5645--202.easyPrerequisites:
Stenn has "Artifact" chosen.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5330-5645--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stenn.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

789-2738-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Gutter Grime, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3525-4289-7937.description:
Activate Badgey by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgey triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Badgey.
Repeat.

1292-3117-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2724-3217-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
2724-3217-7334.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Neutrinos. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-5686-7218.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reaping Willow.
When Reaping Willow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3773-5686-6972--112.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cultivator of Blades.
When Cultivator of Blades dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Cultivator of Blades enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
3773-5686-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Cultivator of Blades's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

640-2173-2511-5010.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Dross Harvester trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

1399-1606-3664-4452.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1913-2073-3698--90.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact with mana value 1 or less.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Imotekh trigger, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Salvaging Station triggers twice, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3490-6097.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-6097.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1365-2438-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2438-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1766-1978-2416.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Rise and Shine.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2511-3327.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-2511-3327.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

575-1113-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Patron of the Wild, adding {C}{C}.
When Patron of the Wild dies, Yedora triggers, returning Patron of the Wild from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Patron of the Wild by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Patron of the Wild's morph ability by paying {2}{G}, turning it face up.
Patron of the Wild triggers, giving target creature +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

938-1582-1812-2034-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
938-1582-1812-2034-3771.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marang River Prowler, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Cast Marang River Prowler from your graveyard for {U}.
Ominous Roost triggers, creating a 1/1 Bird creature token.
Repeat.
